name: haradashi-biron-dialogue
reviewNotes: All 32 source records reviewed. Translate 22 comprehensible records only; preserve original language-state records 13,15,17,19,23,24,25,29,30,31. Record 13 is romanized speech; the other nine use the original invented Biron script.
Preserve chief 大里's explanation of Satokichi's tail belief, feeding responses, both character-name fields in the tail-patting scene, and established 分福茶釜 terminology.
Future integration must keep all ten unselected source records intact. Preserve repeated tea-kettle hints and the separate location rumor at 鬼爪痕.

「哈啦呵囉嘻咧！」


「我們在山明水秀的村子，
安靜過日子就夠了！
這個不需要，送你吧！」
